summary: Peace Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K to report the effectiveness of its S-1 registration statement for its initial public offering (IPO) on May 21, 2026. The filing attaches standard IPO-related agreements (underwriting, warrant, rights, trust, registration rights, etc.) and its amended charter. No business combination, acquisition, or other special situation is disclosed; this is a routine IPO prospectus filing. The registrant is the issuer of its own securities, not a party to a special-situation deal. As a SPAC IPO filing, it is a capital formation event, not a SPAC business combination or any other categorized event.
